name: Tuscumbia RV Park
note: RV park on US-72 at the west edge of Tuscumbia with 50 shady full-hookup sites (20/30/50 amp, pull-in and pull-through, up to 45 ft) plus 8 cottages, bathhouse, laundry and clubhouse. Nightly $42-45 (2026). Many long-term residents alongside overnighters. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
